text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: ...No, I was just focusing my mind.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"I will not make the same mistake again. 
To avenge my past defeat, I have polished 
this 'Holy Sword.'"

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: —Thou shalt not retreat before the enemy.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
No matter how many defeats she suffers, 
she stands on the battlefield without 
fear.
